svg.title: hybrid-layouts
svg.desc: Layer strips for 13 production models 2024–2026, read from config.json and scaled to equal width: blue global attention, light blue sliding window, purple recurrent, green sparse, split cells parallel. Right: KV per token for the growing layers in BF16, computed from config, log scale: Jamba 16 KiB, MiniMax-Text-01 40, Gemma 3 27B 80, Nemotron-H-56B 40, Falcon-H1-34B 144, gpt-oss-120b 36, Qwen3-Next 24, MiniMax-M2 248, Kimi Linear 7.9, Nemotron 3 Nano 6, Qwen3.5-397B 30, MiniMax-M3 120, Kimi K3 27; Llama-3.1-70B reference 320.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: KV/tok = Σℓ ∈ G cℓ (global layers only; SWA bounded by W, recurrent by |S|)
split cell = attention ∥ SSM in one layer · * token mixers only (FFN/MoE omitted)
